0022600181.text: The Rockets host the Timberwolves in their ninth game of the 2026-27 season. Houston is 7-1, 4-0 at home, first in the Southwest and first in the West, and riding a two-game win streak, while Minnesota is 5-3, eighth in the West and one game back of third in the Northwest, on a one-game win streak. The teams have not met yet this season, and Houston lost their 2025-26 series 1-2, including a 136-132 defeat in Houston on April 10, 2026. Steven Adams is out for Houston with a calf strain, and Clint Capela is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision.
